svg.title: ESP32-S3 GPIO map
svg.text: By GPIO number, as used in sketches. Match your board by GPIO number, not by its pin position.
Colours come from the pin rules the firmware itself enforces when you move a pin in the dashboard.
boot (strapping) pin: allowed, mind the level at reset
GPIO 26–32 are the SPI flash. On modules with octal PSRAM or flash (R8, N16) GPIO 33–37 are used too.
GPIO 19 and 20 are the native USB pins. ADC2 (GPIO 11–20) is not used for sensors.
"Serial" marks the console UART, "ADC1" the analog inputs that keep working with Wi-Fi.
